plainTranslation: Their Venus in your 8th house makes affection feel intimate, private, and high stakes. Attraction can deepen fast and may stir possessiveness or fear of loss. Build trust slowly so desire does not become leverage.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
